question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 6,624 at 9.5% p.a. in 4 years, at simple interest. What will be the simple interest (in Rs) on the same sum at the same rate in 6(1)/(2) years?
solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs. 6,624 at 9.5% p.a. in 4 years, at simple interest.

Formula used:

Simple Interest (SI) = [Principal (P) × Rate of interest (R) × Time(T)] /100

Concept used:

Amount = Principal + Interest

Calculation:

Let the principal be P

As per the question,

6624 - P = (P × 9.5 × 4 / 100)

⇒ P + (38P / 100) = 6624

⇒ 138P / 100 = 6624

⇒ P = 6624 × 100 / 138

⇒ P = Rs 4800

In 2nd case, the simple interest will be 

SI = (4800 × 9.5 × 6.5) / × 100

⇒ 24 × 9.5 × 13 = Rs 2964

**The simple interest will be Rs 2964**
